rows.title: Billing reconciliation stamps a Stripe subscription's ordering clock with its FUTURE current_period_end, after which cancellation/past-due webhooks are refused as 'older' and the account can stay PRO indefinitely
rows.rootCause: Two incompatible clocks (event creation time vs period end) share one monotonic ordering column.

rows.title: Discard racing direct-capture completion signs a soft-deleted record, writes DELETED-then-SIGNED custody, and answers bound:true
rows.rootCause: Two different advisory-lock keys guard the same record; the finalize claim predicate omits deletedAt.

rows.title: Acquisition statement says the capture session was 'started before the capture'; UC-1 and UC-2 open it after the capture and the server never checks
rows.rootCause: Statement written for the mobile path and reused for modes that do not satisfy it.

rows.title: 'Direct capture' provenance (e.g. 'PROOVRA's own adapter produced the bytes') is selected by the caller's mode string with no client proof
rows.rootCause: Mode is a caller-supplied enum; no binding between token audience/device and mode.

rows.title: Public /transition lets a token holder mark an intake session SUBMITTED without finalizing: link use is consumed, one-time link expires, Evidence stays CREATED
rows.rootCause: SUBMITTED is allowed over the public route; transitionIntakeSession increments usedCount and expires one-time links but never calls completeEvidence, emits no EXTERNAL_INTAKE_SUBMITTED and links no request response. The web page never calls /transition.

rows.title: A failed part PUT permanently blocks the intake session and the contributor is told the workspace refused
rows.rootCause: A part row whose object was never written makes every submit 404 at completion, which is classified as an expected denial and rendered as a workspace refusal plus a tenant audit 'evidence.create denied'. Re-posting the index returns PART_INDEX_TAKEN.

rows.title: Any intake link holder can exhaust the workspace's evidence-record allowance with never-submitted records
rows.rootCause: Each GET opens a new session; the first part creates a durable Evidence row that counts against the rolling cap regardless of status; nothing reaps it. About 3 requests per row within the per-token rate limit.

rows.title: 'Request more' follow-up submissions never reach the evidence request
rows.rootCause: The follow-up link is never written to evidenceRequest.intakeLinkId, so linkResponseFromIntakeSession finds no request.

rows.title: Parts can be added to an intake record while it is being signed or after it is signed; the worker then includes them
rows.rootCause: addExternalEvidencePart checked the session read at route start and took no completion lock.
rows.canonicalAuthority: writeEvidencePart with an INTAKE_SESSION principal (the same evidence lock finalize holds)
rows.redTest: no baseline red: the writer did not exist; the defect is source-proven in the audit
rows.greenTest: services/api/test/evidence-part-writer.integration.test.ts [ET-INT-05: the intake principal is refused once the record is signed]

rows.title: After initialization the upgrade follow-up collapses onto the running job itself, so no newly stamped proof is ever upgraded
rows.rootCause: The selfJobId escape hatch added for the production 'stuck PENDING' incident was applied only to the upgrade branch, not to the init branch that runs under the same canonical id.

rows.title: Self follow-up job id `-next-` is deterministic and collides with its own retained completed job, so the ladder dies silently on the third hop
rows.rootCause: The discriminated id contains no nonce and the self-reference branch bypasses the spent-job release that the normal branch performs.

rows.title: Package custody.json payloads are rewritten after hashing, so the included hash chain cannot be recomputed (reads as tampered)
rows.rootCause: Role-safe relabelling applied to the forensic export instead of only to display surfaces.

rows.title: Package seal/manifest signing key is only self-asserted inside the ZIP; PROOVRA publishes no fingerprint, yet UI and seal docs claim a bound, checkable seal
rows.rootCause: Seal designed with an external trust-anchor step that was never implemented on Public Verify.

rows.title: Legacy read gate and the byte-release gate's membership lookup ignore access expiry and organization lifecycle: expired members and members of SUSPENDED/ARCHIVED organizations can read, write collaboration content and download originals/reports/packages
rows.rootCause: Two read gates: canonical getEvidenceWithRecordAccess vs legacy getEvidenceWithReadAccess; download gate re-implements membership lookup.

rows.title: Stale standing authority: CaseAccess grants and case ownership survive suspension/revocation and are honored without membership re-proof (legacy read gate, case-workspace requireCaseAccess, bulk case status, attach/detach)
rows.rootCause: Case-level grants treated as independent authority.

rows.title: Creator identity alone grants read, write and moderation on workspace-bound evidence after the creator leaves the workspace (contradicts canonical 'creator grants nothing')
rows.rootCause: The legacy gate predates the Phase-1 canonical rule and keeps a creator shortcut; the routes were never migrated to getEvidenceWithRecordAccess.

rows.title: Restore-from-trash 'succeeds' (200 + EVIDENCE_RESTORED custody) while the destruction executor holds its claim; executor then tombstones the restored record
rows.rootCause: The capability projection resolved PENDING_DESTRUCTION back to TRASHED, so restore was permitted while the executor destroyed the record.
rows.canonicalAuthority: applyEvidenceLifecycleAction write step under the evidence lock refuses a decided claim (DESTRUCTION_IN_PROGRESS)
rows.redTest: no baseline red recorded; the defect is source-proven in the audit
rows.greenTest: services/api/test/legal-hold-destruction-serialization.integration.test.ts [ET-SEC-06: restore is refused while the executor holds a decided claim]
rows.compatibilityImpact: new block reason DESTRUCTION_IN_PROGRESS (shared and web types)

rows.title: Evidence relationships link records across workspaces; target metadata leaks to the source workspace's readers
rows.rootCause: The relationship route authorizes source and target independently and never applies the evaluateCrossTeamAttach equality used for case links; the listing does not re-authorize the target per viewer.

rows.title: RFC3161 responses are accepted as STAMPED without signature, certificate-chain, trust-anchor, nonce or policy validation
rows.rootCause: Timestamp service treats openssl's human-readable print as validation; verification step was never implemented (the 'verify' OTel span wraps only the regex parse).

rows.title: Every read-side 'timestamp digest matches' check compares the sent digest to itself
rows.rootCause: timestamp.service returns messageImprint: digestHex instead of parsed.messageImprintHex.

rows.title: POST /v1/evidence authorizes by membership status only, so VIEWERs, members with expired access and members of SUSPENDED orgs can create workspace Evidence
rows.rootCause: createEvidence uses a hand-rolled membership check instead of the canonical access engine.

rows.title: Interrupted web captures leave Evidence in UPLOADING permanently; these rows count against record caps and are never reaped
rows.rootCause: The row is reserved before upload, the cap predicate ignores status, and nothing reaps stale rows.

rows.title: Malware scan, the evidence.completed webhook and finalization fanout fire once after commit; a retention or lock-snapshot failure or a crash skips them permanently
rows.rootCause: Fire-once work runs after the commit with no outbox.

rows.title: The size limit is checked only after every part has been streamed and hashed inside a 120s interactive DB transaction, and the presigned PUT does not limit Content-Length
rows.rootCause: The size check runs after the streaming loop, and the I/O runs inside the DB transaction.

rows.title: Trash releases a FREE record slot but Restore-from-trash re-admits the record with no cap check, so FREE (and the frozen downgrade cap) can be exceeded without limit
rows.rootCause: Slot release was designed (comment at billing-enforcement.service.ts:409) without a matching re-admission check on the reverse transition.

rows.title: Stripe credit refunds and chargebacks never reverse evidence credits (only PayPal is handled)
rows.rootCause: The 2026-09-28 refund work was PayPal-only.

rows.title: A lapsed (PAST_DUE beyond grace) or ambiguous (two live subscriptions) paid account cannot create ANY evidence — worse than FREE and unable to spend purchased credits
rows.rootCause: The lifecycle gate is plan-agnostic and precedes the funding policy.

rows.title: Chain-of-custody transfers never write a custody event: the event type does not exist in the enum and the failure is swallowed
rows.rootCause: Enum value never added; `as any` hides the type error; silent catch hides the runtime error.

rows.title: Legal hold place/release reach the custody chain only best-effort: silent failure, CASE scope capped at 1000 in one Promise.all burst, WORKSPACE scope and later-linked evidence never recorded
rows.rootCause: Custody treated as a notification fan-out rather than part of the hold mutation.

rows.title: custody_events and admin_audit_logs are append-only only by convention: no trigger or REVOKE, unkeyed hash, and a fully hash-stripped chain verifies as 'legacy' valid
rows.rootCause: Integrity relies on application discipline only.

rows.title: Admin audit hash chain can fork under API/worker clock skew or same-millisecond writes, so the verifier reports a break with no tampering
rows.rootCause: Ordering key is app-clock time plus a random UUID rather than commit order.

rows.title: A retried package build (PACKAGE_FOR_VERSION) selects custody by atUtc instead of sequence, so custody.json can contain a sequence gap and broken prevHash links while claiming to be complete
rows.rootCause: Time-based cut-off on an app-clock field instead of the recorded sequence cut-off.

rows.title: Presigned ORIGINAL URLs issued by the parts listing, record views and public verify leave no custody event; only /original is recorded, and EVIDENCE_DOWNLOADED is never emitted
rows.rootCause: Custody recording is tied to one route rather than to the presign authority.

rows.title: Unlock writes no custody event and EVIDENCE_LOCKED serves two meanings, so the timeline says 'Evidence record locked' after the record is unlocked
rows.rootCause: Unlock never added to the custody model.

rows.title: Exchange package custody-chain.json omits payloads (hashes cannot be recomputed), truncates at 500 events, and turns a DB error into an empty chain
rows.rootCause: Best-effort export design.

rows.title: Retention auto-extension fires on ANY recent custody event, including anonymous public VERIFY_VIEWED, and the extension itself is not recorded in custody
rows.rootCause: An unfiltered 'any custody event' predicate.

rows.title: Many material governance mutations commit first and append custody in a separate transaction with a SILENT catch, so a failure leaves the mutation done and the chain missing it with no signal
rows.rootCause: Incomplete migration to the observable pattern.

rows.title: Extension OAuth accepts any chromiumapp.org extension id when EXTENSION_OAUTH_REDIRECT_ALLOW is unset, with no consent step
rows.rootCause: Permissive default for unset config.

rows.title: No reaper for ACTIVE/INTERRUPTED direct-capture sessions; the extension never discards, so failed captures leave permanent empty Evidence rows and orphan objects
rows.rootCause: Reaper scoped to drafts.

rows.title: Fixed 1h session TTL strands continuous captures finalized late; local segments are already deleted so the recording is unrecoverable
rows.rootCause: TTL not sized for the continuous mode.

rows.title: reserveDirectCaptureEvidence runs createEvidence on the global client inside an outer transaction, so a failed reserve leaves an unbound committed Evidence row and a retry mints a second
rows.rootCause: createEvidence does not accept a tx client.

rows.title: UC-2/UC-3/UC-5 screen captures always open in the personal workspace (no teamId), misfiling team work and refusing managed identities
rows.rootCause: D13 fix applied to one caller only.

rows.title: Continuous-capture continuity/completeness is client-asserted; the only downstream completeness check reads session status, which is always BOUND for sealed records
rows.rootCause: Validator scope minimal.

rows.title: maxBytesPerSession and ipAllowlistCidrs are stored but never enforced
rows.rootCause: Operator-configured restrictions have no effect.

rows.title: Evidence-request send and request-more mint intake links without the plan and governance gates
rows.rootCause: canCreateIntakeLink (allowAnonymousIntake etc.) is skipped; a post-downgrade send still mints links.

rows.title: Cancelling/closing an evidence request does not revoke its link; submissions keep finalizing and attach responses to the cancelled request
rows.rootCause: transitionEvidenceRequest does not revoke.

rows.title: ONE_TIME link use and per-session Evidence creation are check-then-write races
rows.rootCause: Concurrent submits on a one-time link finalize N records; concurrent first-part POSTs create two Evidence rows, one orphaned; maxFileCountPerSession not atomic; duplicate EXTERNAL_INTAKE_SUBMITTED custody.

rows.title: Integrations-API intake-link and evidence-request routes pass an API-credential id as a User id
rows.rootCause: FK to User makes create fail P2003, returned as 400 with raw e.message; also skips assertWorkspaceAllowsIntake.

rows.title: Intake consent is client-asserted: acceptedAtUtc taken from the body, termsAcknowledged/disclosure hash never checked, consent re-postable
rows.rootCause: Custody records 'consent accepted' for termsAcknowledged:false with a backdated timestamp.

rows.title: Intake submitter attribution: identity snapshot and public Verify name the link creator, not the contributor; surfaces disagree
rows.rootCause: IDENTITY_SNAPSHOT_RECORDED carries the creator's email/provider/level; Verify shows it with no intake branch; report and package relabel.

rows.title: Intake submit can report failure after finalization; governance-denied retries append EXPORT_BLOCKED_BY_POLICY custody per anonymous retry
rows.rootCause: Contributor sees 500 'try again' while record is SIGNED; anonymous retries grow custody.

rows.title: Soft-deleted in-progress intake Evidence is reused for new parts
rows.rootCause: Intake reused session.evidenceId without a deletedAt filter.
rows.canonicalAuthority: writeEvidencePart refuses a soft-deleted record as not found
rows.greenTest: services/api/test/evidence-part-writer.integration.test.ts [ET-INT-14: a soft-deleted in-progress record is not found, never reused]

rows.title: No automatic or operator recovery exists for a PENDING (or FAILED) row whose job is gone; pending_aged guidance falsely says the ladder is still running
rows.rootCause: Recovery modelled only the finalize->enqueue handoff; the ladder was assumed self-sustaining.

rows.title: A calendar/network failure during `ots stamp` is persisted as per-record FAILED (no proof), never retried automatically, and its raw error text is shown publicly
rows.rootCause: The failure-vocabulary split described in ots-lifecycle.ts:495-535 is implemented on the wrong side of the try in ots.service.ts.

rows.title: README HOW TO VERIFY ignores the format-5 seal and points recipients at the manifest signature that does not cover the report or checksum index
rows.rootCause: Format 5 added without updating buildReadme.

rows.title: Signed package-manifest.json asserts contents.verifyHtml and verificationScript = true but no such files are emitted
rows.rootCause: Removal of local inspection tool did not update hard-coded flags.

rows.title: Public Verify "Package Integrity Complete / Independent Review Enabled" is derived from file-name presence, never from seal or signature verification
rows.rootCause: Presence booleans used as integrity verdict.

rows.title: Public Verify storage "verified/Immutable Storage Locked" comes from a DB snapshot (no expiry check, no object check); integrity verdict is DB self-consistency only
rows.rootCause: Snapshot fallback labelled verified.

rows.title: Public verify capability is the permanent evidence UUID: published by default, no expiry, no rotation, no per-recipient revocation
rows.rootCause: Verify URL reuses the primary key.

rows.title: Package eligibility gate (hold / lifecycle / destruction review / immutable drift) is skipped for personal workspaces and when the Team row resolves isPersonal=null
rows.rootCause: Gate scoped to team mode.

rows.title: MediaIntelligenceRun rows for perceptual hashes, technical metadata, text-similarity and deferred kinds never leave PENDING, so the intelligence-run reconciler re-runs them every 10 minutes forever and starves genuinely stranded runs
rows.rootCause: Run-state writes live in individual handlers and three handlers plus the early-return branches were never wired to the tracker.

rows.title: A redaction derivative that hits a transient storage error or a worker crash after its claim is stuck in RENDERING forever; retries, the reconciler and a user re-request all skip it
rows.rootCause: Claim predicate has no expired-lease arm; reconciler population excludes RENDERING.

rows.title: Trash-grace reconciler re-reads the same oldest 200 TRASHED rows every hour; once 200 of them are blocked (hold, retention, object lock, approval pending) eligible records are never purged, and the purge job's own BLOCKED reschedule is a no-op
rows.rootCause: Head-of-line ordering on a population that contains permanently or long-blocked members.

rows.title: 14 of 15 BullMQ workers and 4 sweeps start claiming work at module import, before secrets hydration, package-signer validation and object-lock bootstrap
rows.rootCause: autorun default and top-level scheduler starts.

rows.title: OTS budget-exhausted incident (WORKER, OTS:<id>:GLOBAL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED) can never auto-resolve and tells operators the record will recover on its own
rows.rootCause: Probe/fingerprint shape mismatch plus category-level remediation mapping.

rows.title: Recovery decision refuses team_id-NULL Personal records (WORKSPACE_UNRESOLVED) that the durable writer and worker now accept
rows.rootCause: The 2026-09-29 writer change was applied to the writer and one executor branch, not to the facts loader.

rows.title: Mobile Operations shows 'Retry after exhausted failure' but never sends the required reason, so it always fails with 400
rows.rootCause: Projection field dropped in mobile parser.

rows.title: A failed or retryable request on a record that already has a report is invisible to every Reports card and filter while the row shows Retry / 'Escalated to operators'
rows.rootCause: Two consumers of the same facts: the state derivation ranks artifact availability above generation failure; the action resolver consults afterLatestReport failures. The page's card set is built only from the state.

rows.title: Request-level BLOCKED (stale policy / policy block) is uncounted for reports and mislabelled 'not requested' in rows, while 'Packages blocked' counts rows that say 'Package not requested'
rows.rootCause: Legacy five-value vocabulary maps request-level BLOCKED to not_requested; the package 'blocked' label is keyed on governance metadata, not on the canonical state the card counts.

rows.title: Report PDF prints 'Legal Hold: OFF' from the inert S3 object-lock flag even when a canonical evidence legal hold is ACTIVE
rows.rootCause: Storage-layer field reused as the legal-hold statement after S3 legal hold was retired; canonical section never wired.

rows.title: Repeat /complete on a REPORTED record returns without alreadyFinalized, re-running the one-time fan-out (duplicate EVIDENCE_COMPLETED custody event, evidence.completed webhook, malware scan, post-finalize)
rows.rootCause: The REPORTED short-circuit was written before the alreadyFinalized flag existed and was never updated to set it, unlike the SIGNED branch.

rows.title: Archive/trash/restore/unarchive are check-then-write: read + hold evaluation outside the transaction, write by id only, no lock
rows.rootCause: Lifecycle writers (lifecycle service, governance orchestrator, executor tombstone) validated on a read and wrote WHERE id only.
rows.canonicalAuthority: lifecycle service: locked re-read + fresh capability + conditional updateMany; governance transitionLifecycle: locked conditional updateMany (no destruction claim); executor tombstone: conditional on its own claim
rows.redTest: no baseline red recorded; the defect is source-proven in the audit

rows.title: completeUploadSession can move an ABORTED session to COMPLETED (write guard only excludes COMPLETED)
rows.rootCause: The complete write predicate only excludes COMPLETED instead of requiring a non-terminal state, so an abort committed after the read is overwritten.

rows.title: Report regeneration / NEW_VERSION bypasses workspace governance policy (requireReviewBeforeReport, allowReportDownload, template overlay)
rows.rootCause: Workspace governance (enforceSensitiveAction/finalization-governance) was wired only into finalization, and the recovery/regenerate path was added later using the capability check alone.

rows.title: AI categorization run (paid, budget-consuming mutation) gated by legacy READ access only; AI policy evaluated without role/plan inputs
rows.rootCause: The route reused the read gate for a mutating, budget-consuming action and omitted role and plan inputs to the AI policy.

rows.title: Two case-link authorities: bulk ADD/REMOVE_FROM_CASE use a weaker case check than the single routes; case-workspace detach vs cases detach disagree on teamId reset
rows.rootCause: Bulk actions and case-workspace routes each implemented their own case authorization and detach semantics instead of calling one case-link authority.

rows.title: Case-delete legal-hold check fails OPEN on DB error before hard-deleting the case and detaching all evidence
rows.rootCause: The catch block returns the success value instead of failing closed, contradicting the helper's own fail-closed intent.

rows.title: GET /v1/reports skips authorizeOrFail (bare ACTIVE-status membership, no permission/expiry/org-lifecycle); fallback query drops deletedAt/lifecycle filters
rows.rootCause: The route predates authorizeOrFail and hand-rolls membership; the fallback query was written as a separate where object rather than reusing the primary builder.

rows.title: Exchange package signed URL (issued behind generate_package + step-up) is persisted and returned to any evidence.read member by list
rows.rootCause: The bearer URL is stored as a column and serialized by the list projection instead of being minted on demand behind the privileged action.

rows.title: Report/package backlog computed by five aggregators with three rules (entitlement-narrowed relation test, column test, un-narrowed); dashboard 'entitled' ignores subscription lifecycle while worker issuance honors it
rows.rootCause: Each dashboard implemented its own owed-output predicate; evidence-output-eligibility uses plan capabilities only while the worker uses the lifecycle-aware shared resolver.

rows.title: Case risk 'integrity' signal reads evidence_integrity_snapshots, which is backfilled once for SIGNED/REPORTED only and never refreshed, so it cannot report FAILED rows
rows.rootCause: The risk engine reads a denormalized snapshot table whose only writer is a one-time backfill that excludes failed rows and is never refreshed.

rows.title: Storage-used population differs between evidence creation (includes legacy NULL-team rows) and completion/worker (strict team) for personal workspaces
rows.rootCause: getWorkspaceUsage branches on whether the caller passed null or the personal team id instead of using the shared workspace-scope population.

rows.title: Pricing page says FREE storage add-ons 'Not available' while shared commercial policy and API allow FREE storage add-on purchase
rows.rootCause: The pricing page hard-codes the add-on row instead of reading the shared commercial policy.

rows.title: Two reapers expire the same capture drafts; the API sweep writes EXPIRED events for all selected rows, not only those it transitioned
rows.rootCause: Two reapers exist for the same rows and the API sweep builds events from the selected set, not from rows it actually transitioned.

rows.title: API-key upload path bypasses organization-lifecycle denial enforced on the user upload path
rows.rootCause: The integration auth path was built on API-key validity alone and never calls the organization-lifecycle check embedded in authorizeOrFail.

rows.title: Redaction derivative download presigns bytes outside the canonical byte-release gate (no legal-hold/export-eligibility evaluation)
rows.rootCause: The byte-release gate's ArtifactKind union never included redaction derivatives, so the redaction route presigns directly.

rows.title: Exchange-package build race after 30-min lease expiry: late builder overwrites fixed object key after the winner committed READY with its sha; failure path unconditionally marks build FAILED
rows.rootCause: The object upload happens before the conditional READY transition at a fixed key, and the FAILED write is not fenced by the attempt.

rows.title: Report commit (phase C) writes status=REPORTED with WHERE id only, so it can overwrite FAILED_HASH_MISMATCH and commit a Report on a trashed/destroyed record
rows.rootCause: The 2026-09 reserve/render/commit split moved the status guard to phase A and left the phase-C write unconditional.

rows.title: Several original-byte paths still address latest-at-key instead of the signed storageVersionId (verify-content viewUrl, retention apply + lock snapshot, archive tier), while the owner can still write new versions at the key
rows.rootCause: Version pinning was retrofitted to selected readers; key-addressed helpers (presignGetObject without versionId, applyObjectRetention, headObject, copyObjectStorageClass, restoreObject) were not converted.

rows.title: Integrity re-hash (FAILED_HASH_MISMATCH gate) runs only inside report generation; records without report entitlement are never re-verified, and the declared reconciler/completion sources are dead
rows.rootCause: Hard gate was attached to the report pipeline, which is commercially gated.

rows.title: Evidence library status maps (web + mobile mirror) render FAILED_HASH_MISMATCH as a neutral 'Status not recorded'; UPLOADED is a dead enum still driving UI copy and probes
rows.rootCause: Enum value added (Phase A0) without updating the frontend switch statements; mirrors hand-copied.

rows.title: Granted reply without a parseable imprint (incl. granted status with no timeStampToken) is persisted as STAMPED
rows.rootCause: The 'hard invariant' was written to stop false FAILED after a parser bug, and over-corrected into fail-open for missing imprint.

rows.title: Verification package ships FAILED (rejected / imprint-mismatched) replies as timestamp.tsr and the README says 'Included' without the FAILED status
rows.rootCause: Bytes preserved for the repair tool are reused as a presence signal downstream.

rows.title: Multipart TSA imprint is the undocumented '|'-joined composite, while the package tells reviewers the reproducible digest is the LF-joined manifest hash
rows.rootCause: Two composite definitions coexist; the TSA uses the legacy one.

rows.title: Provider-unavailable, rejected and invalid-token outcomes all collapse to tsaStatus=FAILED; failureCode is not persisted
rows.rootCause: Two-value status column; code field never mapped to persistence.

rows.title: One aborted or expired upload session blocks finalization of its evidence forever; the idempotency key returns the terminal session on retry
rows.rootCause: Finalize gate treats ABORTED/EXPIRED the same as in-flight; idempotency lookup ignores state.

rows.title: seed-home-personas.ts writes fabricated SIGNED evidence and custody into whatever DATABASE_URL dotenv loads, guarded only by NODE_ENV
rows.rootCause: Guard copied inconsistently across seed scripts.

rows.title: The required-checklist gate enforces a plan the client wrote (intakePlanJson), and the template identity stamp does not check who owns the capture session
rows.rootCause: The server trusts the client's plan.

rows.title: The record-cap count is read without a lock, and SHARED workspaces are not re-checked at completion
rows.rootCause: Check-then-write with no lock.

rows.title: POST /v1/evidence/:id/parts has no upper bound on partIndex, no cap on part count, and no rate limit
rows.rootCause: No bound is defined.

rows.title: Historical FREE records are not issued automatically after upgrade unless a default-OFF flag is set; customer-initiated Generate bypasses the 'confirmed payment' rule during grace
rows.rootCause: Rollout gate left off by default; manual path not aligned with mayIssueHistoricalFirstOutputs.

rows.title: Redaction publication and derivatives, and reviewer workflow decisions, never reach the evidence custody chain; they live in unhashed, mutable side tables
rows.rootCause: Separate activity logs for these domains.

rows.title: Customer timelines render raw event codes and misleading or duplicate events
rows.rootCause: Event-type reuse and presentation shortcuts.

rows.title: Tenant audit seals raw client IP and User-Agent into hashed metadata (bypassing the masking the column path applies), and never fills the requestId column
rows.rootCause: The facade envelope lacks ip/UA/requestId fields.

rows.title: Capture trust-event sub-chain read-then-insert with no lock and no unique (session, sequence) — concurrent declarations fork the chain
rows.rootCause: No serialization.

rows.title: CAPTURE_MANIFEST relabel happens after the seal outside the signed fingerprint; extension token can presign parts on any owned unsealed evidence; draft route uses a hand-rolled membership check; dead device-identity code
rows.rootCause: Incremental UC work.

rows.title: Intake P3s: dead first-part capture-environment write, false magic-byte comment, UPLOAD_AUTHORIZED for an original URL never issued, swallowed LINK_USED/CONSENT custody failures, unvalidated caseId/evidenceId, stale citizen-capture comment
rows.rootCause: Low-risk inconsistencies.

rows.title: Initializer still promotes to ANCHORED from `ots upgrade` text alone (heuristic removed elsewhere); such an anchor is never re-checked when a txid is present
rows.rootCause: The 2026-09-29 removal of the text-only promotion covered classifyOtsResult but not createOpenTimestamp.

rows.title: A header-valid but unparseable proof (or block attestation without readable txid) is treated as transient forever and never reaches a terminal state
rows.rootCause: No distinction between network-transient and deterministic proof-read failures.

rows.title: Package verification hint `ots verify opentimestamps-proof.ots` cannot succeed; the stamped file is fingerprint.json
rows.rootCause: Proof renamed without adjusting the hint.

rows.title: Anonymous GET writes audit + verification_views (raw IP/UA, no retention) + evidence row + debounced custody event
rows.rootCause: Analytics stored as raw PII.

rows.title: historical-verification-material.json leaks key path or KMS key id and lists SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH for every purpose including the package signer
rows.rootCause: Single extraction reused for all purposes.

rows.title: BASIC verify says a report copy "can be checked" via its recorded digest, but no digest is returned
rows.rootCause: Data minimization over-applied vs copy.

rows.title: /verify/[token] has no noindex/robots control; web error path sends the token to Sentry
rows.rootCause: Omission.

rows.title: Single-file evidence entry at ZIP root can collide with a fixed entry name when no capture/upload timestamp exists
rows.rootCause: Root placement for single file.

rows.title: Package streams originals without the pinned storageVersionId used by the integrity pre-read
rows.rootCause: Field not propagated.

rows.title: Per-evidence public verify bucket (60/min) is shared by all viewers; two IPs can lock a record page out
rows.rootCause: Shared bucket.

rows.title: Five queues have registered consumers but no producer, and the registry asserts reconcilers/claims that do not exist (graph/org-health recovery, derived-asset recovery, OTS tenant fail-closed, timeoutMs)
rows.rootCause: Registry maintained by hand; closure gate checks file existence, not behaviour.

rows.title: media-intelligence-dlq is a phantom sink (never written) shown as an operator DLQ, and report-dlq entries are written for requests that are still being retried
rows.rootCause: Counters and sinks drifted from the durable request model.

rows.title: Worker job events log an evidenceId the canonical payload never carries, OTS pending-retry classification keys on an error string no longer thrown, and malformed payloads are retried for the full budget
rows.rootCause: Payload shape changed in Point 5; handlers not updated.

rows.title: The embed-owed reconciler selects chunks by the legacy `embedding` column, which nothing writes, so every chunk aged 30min-30d is 'owed' forever
rows.rootCause: Column migration (Bytes -> pgvector) not reflected in the reconciler.

rows.title: Resume OTS anchoring reports QUEUED (and audits success) when the enqueue collapsed onto a live job; ALREADY_IN_PROGRESS branch is dead
rows.rootCause: Adapter reads only `enqueued`, not `collapsed`.

rows.title: Web Operations loses the remediation outcome on 409/503; QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE (work recorded) is shown as 'could not be started'
rows.rootCause: Error body shape not read by the web page.

rows.title: 'Resume OTS anchoring' is offered and answered QUEUED for a permanently invalid proof, which the worker skips
rows.rootCause: Executor precheck only knows ANCHORED/UPGRADED.

rows.title: Remediation audit outcomes misclassify refusals and no-ops
rows.rootCause: Two ad hoc mappings.

rows.title: Platform queue Retry/Replay of a GenerateReportJob whose request is terminal reports success but the worker no-ops
rows.rootCause: Transport-level retry is independent of the durable authority.

rows.title: Communications message manual retry writes no audit row and updates without a state predicate
rows.rootCause: Route predates audit/claim conventions.

rows.title: 'Retry budget exhausted' incident fires at BullMQ attempt 5 while the durable budget (12 claims) keeps retrying
rows.rootCause: Two retry budgets.

rows.title: Every API-side recovery request fires an EVIDENCE_REPORTED automation trigger, before any report exists
rows.rootCause: Trigger bound to request creation by design (ARCH-005 comment).

rows.title: When loadEvidenceOutputFacts fails, every row is given action NONE with reason PERMISSION_DENIED ('Needs permission') while the list section still reports ok
rows.rootCause: Fallback constant reuses PERMISSION_DENIED.

rows.title: Summary shows 'temporarily unavailable' during initial load and permanently on the user-scoped fallback path
rows.rootCause: No 'loading' member in the summary section state; fallback has no summary source.

rows.title: Reports row renders every generation outcome in success green, including TERMINAL, RECOVERABLE_BLOCKED and QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE
rows.rootCause: tone ignored.

rows.title: SUCCEEDED request records the newest report id, not the report the run produced or targeted
rows.rootCause: Run result not returned to caller.

rows.title: Executive conclusion says 'finalized supporting publication materials' when OTS is anchored but not chain-checked
rows.rootCause: Signal status not split by resolveOtsAnchorClaim result.

rows.title: Storage capacity check runs outside the capacity advisory lock; two finalizes in one workspace can both pass
rows.rootCause: The storage check and plan read happen before the per-workspace capacity lock; the per-evidence advisory lock does not serialize different records.

rows.title: Package commit sets evidence verificationPackageVersion without monotonic guard; package-only recovery of an older version regresses the pointer
rows.rootCause: The pointer update is unconditional instead of monotonic.

rows.title: Report request lease has no fencing token; a late worker's markRequestRetryable/terminal write overwrites the re-claimer's PROCESSING row
rows.rootCause: The claim has no fencing token; late writes match on state alone.

rows.title: Existence oracles: 404-vs-403 on case access, capture sessions, cases evidence attach, evidence create with foreign teamId; public verify 409 exposes status of unfinalized records
rows.rootCause: These handlers predate the anti-enumeration convention and return distinct status codes for existing-but-forbidden objects.

rows.title: Annotation PATCH accepts any evidencePartId (no ownership check, unlike POST)
rows.rootCause: The PATCH schema is AnnotationBody.partial() and the ownership check exists only in the POST handler.

rows.title: Caller-supplied caseId/evidenceId on intake links and evidence requests stored without tenant validation (dangling foreign references copied to webhooks)
rows.rootCause: The services validate the template/team but not optional reference ids.

rows.title: Dead exported legal-hold query helpers with optional teamId spread (would be unscoped if ever called)
rows.rootCause: Legacy projection helpers kept after hold convergence with optional tenant spread.

rows.title: Integrity snapshot writes misleading booleans from status (MATERIALS_AVAILABLE => hash/signature/custody true; OTS matches true by status) — no reader; web library labels FAILED_HASH_MISMATCH 'Status not recorded'
rows.rootCause: Status-derived booleans stand in for real checks; the web label map was not extended when FAILED_HASH_MISMATCH was added.

rows.title: TSA failure classifier substring-matches the full execFile error (argv incl. URL and user:password, digest, temp path); real timeouts are never classified as timeouts
rows.rootCause: Heuristic substring classification over an argv-bearing message.

rows.title: Report claims the token is available via a 'technical verification endpoint' that does not exist; comments claim a worker ASN.1 TSA parser that does not exist
rows.rootCause: Copy/comment drift.

rows.title: Manual TSA repair CLI writes STAMPED without the serial+genTime precondition its docstring states, and contradicts the 'written once inside finalize' authority claim
rows.rootCause: Docstring/implementation drift.

rows.title: Idempotent session reuse does not check the returned session belongs to the requested evidenceId
rows.rootCause: Idempotency key not bound to its request parameters.

rows.title: Multipart path never enforces expectedTotalBytes/partSizeBytes, marks parts VERIFIED without a reference hash, and leaves bridged parts without uploadedByUserId
rows.rootCause: Hygiene gaps in the Phase 30.12 path.
